fontFamilies.fontFamily: "Inter", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, "Open Sans", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
fontFamilies.name: Inter

styles.css: html { box-sizing: border-box;} *, *:before, *:after { box-sizing: inherit; } footer.wp-block-template-part {margin-block-start: 0px;} iframe { border: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; vertical-align: middle; width: 100%; min-height: 400px; background: transparent; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .wp-site-blocks .wp-block-site-logo img { height: auto; min-width: 90px; min-height: 60px; width: auto; } } @media (max-width: 767px) { .wp-site-blocks .wp-block-site-logo { flex: 1; flex-basis: auto; } .wp-site-blocks .wp-block-site-logo a { min-width: 80px; } .wp-site-blocks .wp-block-site-logo img { width: auto; } .wp-site-blocks .wp-block-site-logo .custom-logo-link { display: flex; width: 100%; justify-content: center; align-items: center; } } [class*='text-line'] { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; } .text-line-1 { -webkit-line-clamp: 1; line-clamp: 1; } .text-line-2 { -webkit-line-clamp: 2; line-clamp: 2; } .text-line-3 { -webkit-line-clamp: 3; line-clamp: 3; } .text-line-4 { -webkit-line-clamp: 4; line-clamp: 4; } .text-line-5 { -webkit-line-clamp: 5; line-clamp: 5; } .text-line-6 { -webkit-line-clamp: 6; line-clamp: 6; } @media (max-width: 767.98px) { .hide-mobile { display: none !important; } } @media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1023.98px) { .hide-tablet { display: none !important; } } @media (min-width: 1024px) and (max-width: 1439.98px) { .hide-desktop { display: none !important; } } @media (min-width: 1440px) { .hide-fluid { display: none !important; } } footer::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 10%; right: 10%; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3), transparent); } footer .wp-block-heading::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -8px; left: 0; width: 20px; height: 2px; background: var(--wp--preset--color--primary); border-radius: 2px; } .header-right-tools { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 15px; } .jankx-user-menu img { border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); transition: border-color 0.3s; } .jankx-user-menu:hover img { border-color: #3b82f6; }

core/search.css: .wp-block-search__content { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important; backdrop-filter: blur(12px) !important; -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important; border-radius: 50px !important; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .wp-block-search__content:focus-within { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important; border-color: #3b82f6 !important; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); } .wp-block-search__input { background: transparent !important; color: #fff !important; font-size: 14px !important; padding: 6px 15px !important; height: 32px !important; } .wp-block-search__button { background: #3b82f6 !important; border-radius: 50% !important; width: 32px !important; height: 32px !important; padding: 0 !important; margin-right: 2px !important; transition: all 0.2s ease !important; } .wp-block-search__button:hover { background: #2563eb !important; transform: scale(1.05); } .wp-block-search__button svg { width: 16px !important; height: 16px !important; fill: #fff !important; }

core/navigation.css: .wp-block-navigation-item__content { transition: all 0.3s ease; } footer .wp-block-navigation-item__content { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6) !important; } footer .wp-block-navigation-item__content:hover { color: #fff !important; padding-left: 5px; }

core/social-links.css: .wp-block-social-link { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) !important; border-radius: 12px !important; transition: all 0.3s ease !important; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) !important; } .wp-block-social-link:hover { background: #3b82f6 !important; transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4); }
